from.n: instance-children > a named instance > runs the child its parent's `instanceChildren` records for it

to.n: instance-children > a named instance > runs the child its parent's `instanceChildren` records for it, rather than the one it would carry over

from.n: instance-children > a named instance > runs a child of its own when its parent's `instanceChildren` records none for it

to.n: instance-children > a named instance > carries over the child the pattern its parent last set up gives it, when its parent's `instanceChildren` records none for it
